task: Find the tech specs of the MacBook Pro 16-inch introduced in November 2023.
agent_final_answer:
MacBook Pro (16-inch, Nov 2023) - Tech Specs (source: Apple Support, support.apple.com/en-us/117737). Year introduced: 2023.

FINISH: Space Black, Silver.

CHIP:
- Apple M3 Pro: 12-core CPU (6 performance + 6 efficiency cores), 18-core GPU, hardware-accelerated ray tracing, 16-core Neural Engine, 150GB/s memory bandwidth. Media Engine: hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, ProRes RAW; video decode engine; video encode engine; ProRes encode/decode engine; AV1 decode. Configurable to M3 Max.
- Apple M3 Max: 14-core CPU (10+4) or 16-core CPU (12+4); 30-core or 40-core GPU; ray tracing; 16-core Neural Engine; 300GB/s (or 400GB/s with 16-core CPU/40-core GPU) memory bandwidth; two video encode engines; two ProRes encode/decode engines; AV1 decode.

DISPLAY: 16.2-inch (diagonal) Liquid Retina XDR display; 3456-by-2234 native resolution at 254 ppi. 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio. XDR brightness 1000 nits sustained full-screen, 1600 nits peak (HDR content only); SDR brightness 600 nits. 1 billion colors, Wide color (P3), True Tone. ProMotion adaptive refresh rates up to 120Hz.

MEMORY: M3 Pro 18GB unified (configurable to 36GB, or 96GB/48/64/128GB depending on chip); M3 Max 36GB unified (configurable to 96GB or 48/64/128GB).

STORAGE: M3 Pro 512GB SSD (configurable to 1TB/2TB/4TB; 8TB on M3 Max); M3 Max 1TB SSD (configurable to 2TB/4TB/8TB).

BATTERY/POWER: Up to 22 hours Apple TV app movie playback; up to 15 hours wireless web. 100-watt-hour lithium-polymer battery (actual 99.6 Wh). 140W USB-C Power Adapter; USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable; fast-charge capable.

CHARGING & EXPANSION (PORTS): SDXC card slot, HDMI port, 3.5mm headphone jack, MagSafe 3 port, three Thunderbolt 4 (USB-C) ports supporting charging, DisplayPort, Thunderbolt 4 (up to 40Gb/s), USB 4 (up to 40Gb/s).

DISPLAY SUPPORT: M3 Pro up to two external displays (6K at 60Hz over Thunderbolt) plus HDMI (8K at 60Hz or 4K at 240Hz). M3 Max up to four external displays.

WIRELESS: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax); Bluetooth 5.3.
CAMERA: 1080p FaceTime HD camera with advanced image signal processor and computational video.
AUDIO: High-fidelity six-speaker sound system with force-cancelling woofers, wide stereo, Spatial Audio (Dolby Atmos), studio-quality three-mic array; 3.5mm jack with high-impedance headphone support; HDMI multichannel audio output.
KEYBOARD/TRACKPAD: Backlit Magic Keyboard (78 U.S./79 ISO keys), Touch ID, ambient light sensor, Force Touch trackpad.

SIZE & WEIGHT: Height 0.66 in (1.68 cm); Width 14.01 in (35.57 cm); Depth 9.77 in (24.81 cm). Weight 4.7 lb (2.14 kg) for M3 Pro; 4.8 lb (2.16 kg) for M3 Max.

OPERATING SYSTEM: macOS (Sequoia).
IN THE BOX: 16-inch MacBook Pro, 140W USB-C Power Adapter, USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable (2 m).
